title: Small Business Association of Michigan discusses tax changes, interest rates, and more
text:
Brian Calley President and Chief Executive Officer at Small Business Association of Michigan | Official website
Brian Calley President and Chief Executive Officer at Small Business Association of Michigan | Official website
Welcome to SBAM’s Small Business Briefing. Brian Calley and Sarah Miller discuss the latest updates on the bill signed by President Trump, including key tax code changes affecting small businesses. They also cover the Federal Reserve’s recent decisions on interest rates, Michigan’s employment data, and developments in the 2026 election races. The briefing offers insights on economic trends and their impact on small businesses.
